statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The denial reason code is CO-197
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
The monitoring was intended to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The submitted materials do not align with the clinical records currently maintained in the insurer's system
